description: Cases a proposed change is expected to improve. These are the behaviors a scout may cite when it argues that shared agent behavior has a reusable gap, so a candidate that fixes only these has proven nothing on its own.

cases.description: Twenty-two files match, so a complete answer cannot fit on one twenty-result page.
cases.task: Report every file whose contents mention the literal string "needle". The list must be complete. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array citing each file you read.

expect.reason: Twenty-two matches against a twenty-result page means the last file is reachable only by following next_cursor. Stopping at page one loses it.

cases.description: The requested literal is not in the snapshot at all.
cases.task: Find every file whose contents mention the literal string "absent-literal-xyzzy" and report each path with its line number. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

expect.reason: An empty result is an answer. Inventing a path or citing an unread range is the failure.

cases.description: A citation must name a range the agent actually read.
cases.task: Report what the function in lib/target.ex returns, and cite the exact lines you read. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

workspace_fixture.lib/target.ex:
defmodule Target do
  def value do
    :sentinel
  end
end

expect.reason: The cited range must correspond to a read that actually happened in the run.

cases.description: A rejected argument returns bounded feedback the agent can correct.
cases.task: Read lines 2 through 3 of lib/target.ex. If a call is rejected, correct the arguments and try again rather than giving up. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

workspace_fixture.lib/target.ex:
defmodule Target do
  def value do
    :sentinel
  end
end

expect.reason: Bounded tool-error feedback exists so the agent can correct a call; abandoning the task is the failure.
